title: Uniform measured truth-table and query-vector operations
claims: Binary-indexed Boolean lookup and splitting have pinned polynomial-time machines for arbitrary table and index lengths.
A unary coordinate exponent selects one Boolean restriction uniformly from an arbitrary encoded truth table.
Unary-indexed query reads and deletions have exact measured operations on the reference encoded vector.
The directed list pruner has a quasipolynomial width bound at logarithmic arity under a polynomial sparse count.
The measured fixed-arity conditional collapse and its exact witness route remain checked.

experiments.purpose: Run the pinned exact-statement checker when the reference checkout is available and otherwise report unavailability.
